summary: CENTERPOINT Master Architectural Blueprint — a comprehensive 5-part implementation plan covering: (1) Conceptual masterclass on first principles, technology stack audit, and design philosophy; (2) Surgical red-team critique of 6 critical security vulnerabilities in the existing codebase and 5 fragile assumptions; (3) Complete architecture blueprint with mermaid diagrams, 10 implementation phases, and 200+ file mutation manifest; (4) Validation protocol with phase-by-phase acceptance tests; (5) Rollback strategy and failure containment rules. Includes a full feature completion register tracking 55+ capabilities across 14 domains.
